decisions.reason: Marketplace whitelisting for royalty enforcement does not change which book entitlements, referral identity, badges, or prize tickets transfer to a resale buyer.
The ERC-721C choice is an enforcement mechanism for secondary royalties and does not change the collection's unlimited-mint NFT ebook model.
The token-standard and marketplace-policy decision does not alter any currently required metadata field or displayed attribute.
The source confirms a smart-contract enforcement choice but does not request FAQ copy changes; the existing FAQ already states the flat $10 secondary-sale royalty.
Enforcing the existing $10 secondary royalty does not change the Small Block prize amount, draw rules, sale counting, or pool-funding requirement.
The secondary-marketplace royalty mechanism does not change automatic prize delivery to winners.
The source does not change the primary referral-mint trigger, ticket recipient, ticket count, ticket cycle, or rule that secondary sales generate no tickets.
Choosing ERC-721C for royalty enforcement does not change badge triggers, milestones, or on-chain badge recording.
The token standard changes while the required blockchain remains Base, an Ethereum L2.
The secondary-royalty implementation choice has no effect on the deferred Discord community and support server.
The source concerns secondary-sale royalty enforcement and does not change the $15 primary mint price or its primary-sale revenue allocation.
The ERC-721C and marketplace-whitelist decision does not change winner announcement, dashboard notification, email notification, or guidance behavior.
